name: Jason AI
description_en:
The jasonai.tech entry redirects to Reply’s Jason AI page. Official documentation on how.reply.io explicitly identifies Jason AI as Reply’s AI SDR. It generates offers and sequences from a website, files or text, sources contacts, personalizes messages, handles replies from a knowledge base and can book meetings. Approval mode and automatic mode are distinct; its output quality depends on the business context supplied.

A proposed pilot would supply approved company information, inspect the generated ideal customer profile and offer, connect only the required senders, and set conservative sourcing caps. In approval mode every message waits for human approval; deleting a pending message removes the prospect from the sequence. Reply handlers can be Auto, Draft, or Stop and notify by question type. Test an objection, a missing-answer question and a do-not-contact reply before allowing unattended responses.
description_zh:
jasonai.tech 入口跳转到 Reply 的 Jason AI 页面。how.reply.io 官方文档明确把 Jason AI 定义为 Reply 的 AI SDR。它从网站、文件或文本生成卖点与序列，寻找联系人、个性化消息、依据知识库处理回复并可安排会议。人工批准与自动模式不同，输出质量受所提供业务背景影响。

建议试点提供经批准公司资料，检查生成的理想客户与卖点，只连接必要发送端，并设置保守的找客上限。批准模式下每条消息等待人工批准；删除待批准消息会把线索移出序列。回复处理器可按问题类型设为 Auto、Draft 或 Stop and notify。允许无人值守回复前，应测试异议、知识库缺失的问题与不再联系回复。

core_features.explanation_en: Hold generated messages until a human approves.
core_features.explanation_zh: 生成消息等待人工批准。

core_features.name_zh: 基于知识库的回复处理器
core_features.explanation_en: Choose automatic, draft or stop-and-notify handling by question type.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按问题类型选择自动、草稿或停止并通知。

en: Start with an offer, a knowledge base and approval mode
zh: 从卖点、知识库与批准模式起步
use_cases.basis: Illustrative evaluation workflow; not an executed test or customer result.

Evaluation scope.en: Official public documentation research. Account setup, integrations and delivery were not executed.
Evaluation scope.zh: 研究官方公开资料；未实际注册、运行集成或验证交付。

steps.en: A proposed pilot would supply approved company information, inspect the generated ideal customer profile and offer, connect only the required senders, and set conservative sourcing caps. In approval mode every message waits for human approval; deleting a pending message removes the prospect from the sequence. Reply handlers can be Auto, Draft, or Stop and notify by question type. Test an objection, a missing-answer question and a do-not-contact reply before allowing unattended responses.
steps.zh: 建议试点提供经批准公司资料，检查生成的理想客户与卖点，只连接必要发送端，并设置保守的找客上限。批准模式下每条消息等待人工批准；删除待批准消息会把线索移出序列。回复处理器可按问题类型设为 Auto、Draft 或 Stop and notify。允许无人值守回复前，应测试异议、知识库缺失的问题与不再联系回复。

items.en: Documentation states that the per-company sourcing cap defaults to three, a one-time intent search returns at most 500 contacts, and fit scores are per sequence and offer rather than global. Approval throughput is bounded by human review. Jason does not generate AI replies for Do not contact threads. It fits an owned outbound loop with reviewed inputs; it should not be used to assume qualification or accurate factual claims without evaluation. The hosted Reply workflow was not executed, and source licensing, self-hosting and recovery semantics remain unverified.
items.zh: 文档说明每公司找客上限默认三人，单次意向搜索最多返回 500 联系人，匹配分数按序列和卖点计算，而非全局评分。批准模式吞吐受人工审查速度限制。Jason 不为 Do not contact 会话生成 AI 回复。它适合输入受审查且有负责人的触达闭环，不能未经评估就假定资格判断或事实准确。未实际运行托管 Reply 流程，源代码许可、自托管与恢复语义仍未核实。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: The official capability page says AI SDR plans have tier-dependent run and contact allowances, but does not state payable amounts. The linked pricing endpoint returned 403, so current prices, included usage, trial terms and a continuing free tier remain unknown. Do not substitute third-party quoted starting prices or the parent Reply plan’s allowances. Obtain the exact AI SDR subscription and sending/data scope before budgeting.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 官方能力页说明 AI SDR 套餐的执行与联系人数额度因等级而异，没有公布应付金额。链接的定价入口返回 403，因此当前价格、包含用量、试用与长期免费层仍未知。不能套用第三方起价，也不能借用母产品 Reply 套餐额度。预算前应取得具体 AI SDR 订阅及发送／数据范围。
